override._why: From about 30 s: Right x3 to Skip, then A. By 70 s, Controller Select needs controller 1 assigned to the club's side. B then A clears the 'No human teams selected' alert or returns from Play Match. Right, A, A assigns Away and confirms; Up, A selects Play Match from Formation and Tactics. If the club is Home, those inputs only toggle the alert: B, A resynchronizes, then Left, A, A, Up, A starts from Home.
